summary: Vijay Kedar called Aspen Mountain Ski Patrol lost, scared but uninjured near Ludes Lane/Walshes; 13 MRA members deployed, reached him at 5:30pm ~800 vertical ft below boundary, led him down 30-38 degree slopes in dark to valley floor.
location: below ski area boundary near Walshes, Aspen Mountain
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page.
